scope: 42 retained prime m3-9 cases, three arms and two target kinds; source-bound arithmetic only

layout.preparation/stage.tar.gz: Gzip tar of 306 payloads plus manifest.sha256: exact sources, native executable, native test executable, input/source pairs, retained terminal certificates/factors and prior top records
layout.protocol.json: Exact frozen execution contract; canonical hash in freeze block and separate whole-file hash in request
layout.raw/inputs,terminal,top,source: Dependencies copied from staged archive and verified before computation
layout.raw/results/KEY.json: Per-case exact source-bound arithmetic with explicit unverified filtered-space fields and null LFD/regularity
layout.raw/results/KEY.poly: Complete recomputed coefficient polynomial; N83PFF1 encoding described by development format
layout.raw/results/summary.json: All 42 records only if producer completes
layout.raw/producer-status.json,replay-status.j: Started flag and exact exit status; terminal substitutes unattempted status125 when absent
layout.raw/terminal.json: Controller start/end, phase statuses, exit status, backend, wall_valid=false
layout.raw/manifest.sha256: Hash of every raw payload except manifest itself, finalized on controller exit
layout.request.json,submission.json,status-*.js: Exact EKS command, returned identity and observed lifecycle; submission alone does not establish worker execution

custody: Input archive and frozen protocol downloaded from S3 and compared byte-for-byte before submission. Raw outputs require separate post-run S3 restoration and native replay.
failure_semantics: Keep partial and failed attempts. A scheduling or process failure yields no degree bound. Zero pairing is inconclusive. No new LFD or regularity claim.
